name: Allan "dwangoAC" Cecil
biography: dwangoAC (Allan Cecil) is the founder and leader of the TASBot online community and Senior Ambassador on staff of TASVideos.org. He is a published journal author, patent holder, and unflappable presenter with talks at DEF CON, GeekPwn, Thotcon, May Contain Hackers, and other hacker conferences. dwangoAC uses his combined hacking interests for good at charity events like Games Done Quick to entertain viewers with never-before-seen glitches in games, with event content he's led raising more than $1.5m for various charities.
